title: Austin's Parks, Police, Youth & Library Focus
summary:
*   The meeting served as a workshop to review a draft city-wide policy budget.
*   Key discussions focused on proposed budgets and strategic plans for Parks and Recreation.
*   Presentations also detailed the Police Department's policy paper and budget considerations.
*   The agenda included reports on "Opportunities for Youth" programs and city Library services.
